newsitem.title: USA: Midwest dealers apply 10 cents protection on soy.
newsitem.headline: Midwest dealers apply 10 cents protection on soy.

text.p: Widespread cash price protection of 10 cents per bushel was taken on soybeans in Midwest cash markets late Friday, Midwest grain dealers said.
Soybean movement was light but grain dealers said limit-down CBOT soybean futures prompted the action.
A few dealers applied five cents protection and a few others had "basis-only" bids. On basis-only, the seller would not be paid until after the CBOT soybean market opened Monday.
CBOT May soybeans closed down 30 cents at $8.41 per bushel.
